speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Given your young age and the onset of constant vertigo without head trauma, have you noticed any weakness in your limbs, difficulty speaking, or changes in your vision besides the spinning sensation?

text: My main symptom is Sustained sensation of the room spinning. I also have Occasional nausea, Use of diphenhydramine for symptoms and to aid sleep, Recent cold.

text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV) secondary to recent viral upper respiratory infection. REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Brain (to rule out posterior fossa pathology).
